author: Polar_Express
body:
Folks - For any new map makers ( or old) that would like a void map, here it is. I hate when I cant find one , so I made a copy for anyone that needs/wants. It is not a template of any map type, just a map with a stone landing and nothing else but Air and Void.

Blank Map DL :  https://www.dropbox.com/s/ka518a7b487g86x/Voild_blank_2.zip
Pic: http://imgur.com/Apl8sqF

replies.author: Netuxx
replies.body:
No images, no truth on what you said. (I don't want to sound rude, sorry :/ )

They are a lot of ways to do this in Vanilla and with Bukkit plugins.

For Vanilla is just creating a flat world using the layer preset '0;0' and for Bukkit plugins they are a lot in the 'World Editing and Management category'.

But yeah, we appreciate what you did here ^_^

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body: Make a flat world goto presets, type 0:0 in (how Netux said before). Turn autogenerating stuctures off. Creative Gamemode has to be used. Create the World and double tap the spacekey so you are flying. then type "/setblock ~ ~ ~ 1". Now you are done.

replies.author: awesome_apricot
replies.body:
If you have a server, you can just use a plugin such as EmptyWorldGenerator - works great with Multiverse and MultiWorld, /mw create *name* plugin:EmptyWorldGenerator and it makes it for you. 

For single player, this is perfect.
